name: +1 Web Swing Escape
desc:
🕸️ Welcome to +1 Web Swing Escape! 🕸️

HOW TO PLAY:
⚡ Gain +1 Speed every time you move and gain extra web shooters to swing!
💪 Train your speed and unlock powerful new suits.
👥 Race against friends and other players.
🌍 Climb the leaderboards and become the BEST SPIDER on the server.
🚀 Speed is everything, but one wrong move could send you all the way back to the start! 😱

Think you have what it takes to reach the end?
LIKE the game and join the GROUP for Rewards! 👍
